title: Holes & Stars — Compare two missing corners with their complete square
help: The two three-opening masks omit opposite corners of the same square. The third restores all four corners. These are ideal point openings, not square windows. Using changes only the mask; the inspected spot and opening settings stay put.
message: crosses experiments keep their distinct rules and exact supplied choices
facts: Source order is exactly supplied. All within[-1,1], no duplicates. Three-source arrays are oppositely missing corners, not an equal-brightness claim under arbitrary phase/strength/chosen illumination. Preserve envelope/illumination and probe settings.
noteFallback: Other choices keep their existing descriptions.
notes: The omitted corner is at positive x and positive y. Three equal-phase point sources would all agree at the screen origin; other illumination choices remain yours.
The omitted corner is at negative x and negative y. This exchanges which corner is missing; it does not move your screen probe or reset phase and strength choices.
All four corners are present, at x and y values of minus or plus 0.4. More openings change the source sum as well as the gaps; a finite opening envelope remains a separate setting.
